svg.text: SPINE BEAM 250x250x9.0 SHS C350L0, continuous, 3 x 5.0 m lengths, bolted flange-plate splices at 5.0 and 10.0 m
HANGERS: 7 off at 2 000 c/c, 200x300x16 plate + 20 mm lug, 3.25 t bolt-type bow shackle + 2 t bearing swivel each. Posted SWL 100 kg per hanger. See DET-02.
COLUMNS: 4 off 250x250x12.5 SHS C350L0, fixed base on 550x550x32 plate with 4 x M24 cast-in anchors into 1 800 sq x 600 deep N32 pad footings. See DET-01.
BAGS SHOWN: 1.8 m Muay Thai bags, bottom 300 above floor on 0.7 m shackle/swivel/chain sets. Columns padded 25 mm closed-cell foam to 2.0 m. Clear headroom to roof structure 3.6 m min.
Dashed circles: 1.0 m radius swing envelope of a hard-hit bag.
Keep 2.0 m clear each side of the bag line and 1.5 m beyond the end bags.
Anchor group 4 x M24 at 450 x 450 gauge on 550 x 550 x 32 base plate
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — ELEVATION, PLAN, SECTION A-A
Dimensions mm, not to scale. Steel AS 1163 C350L0 / AS/NZS 3678-350, HDG to AS/NZS 4680.
Concrete N32 to AS 3600. Bolts Gr 8.8 HDG. Welds SP to AS/NZS 1554.1.
Beam soffit 3.0 m suits 1.8 m Muay Thai bags (bottom 0.3 m) and 1.2-1.5 m boxing bags on 0.6-0.9 m chain sets. Design bag mass 100 kg per hanger.
Six-bag layout: use hangers 1-3 and 5-7; the 7.5 m position then suits a double-end or speed bag. Do not tie the frame to walls or roof without a separate check.
